leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Import the useTransition hook from React to access its functionality in a TypeScript component.
Define a state variable using useState to control the visibility of a loading indicator.
Invoke the useTransition hook to obtain startTransition and isPending values for managing UI updates.
Implement a handler function that wraps state updates with startTransition to mark them as non-urgent.
Apply conditional rendering to display a loading spinner when isPending is true.
Construct a button element with an onClick handler that triggers the transition-wrapped state update.
Utilize TypeScript generics to properly type the state managed by useState for type safety.
Control UI feedback by toggling between the main content and loading states based on isPending.
Execute asynchronous operations within the transition handler to simulate data fetching.
Modify component structure to include both interactive elements and conditional loading indicators.
Return JSX that integrates the transition-managed UI with the component's existing layout.
Compare the behavior of transition-wrapped updates versus regular state updates in the UI.
